subsubtopic: DISTRIBUTION OF LIBERAL PUBLICATION
speechtext: I have a question for the Prime Minister in the extended absence of the Postmaster General, and it is a question on pollution. speakerposition: Speaker of the House of Commons
subsubtopic: DISTRIBUTION OF LIBERAL PUBLICATION
speechtext: Perhaps I should indicate to the hon. member that this is the kind of question which comes under the jurisdiction of the House rather than of the government. ACADIA FISHING COMPANY AND BOOTH FISHERIES-ASSISTANCE IN MEDIATING STRIKE
speechtext:
I should like to direct a question to the Minister of Labour.


What steps is the minister or his department taking to assist in mediating or bringing to a conclusion the strike of some 230 fishermen against the Acadia Fishing Company and Booth Fisheries in Nova Scotia?

subtopic: ACADIA FISHING COMPANY AND BOOTH FISHERIES-ASSISTANCE IN MEDIATING STRIKE
speechtext: I am uncertain whether this comes under federal jurisdiction. I doubt that it does. If it does not, then it is up to the Department of Labour of the province of Nova Scotia, which I understand can deal with it more than adequately.

subtopic: ACADIA FISHING COMPANY AND BOOTH FISHERIES-ASSISTANCE IN MEDIATING STRIKE
speechtext: Inasmuch as there is some doubt about the jurisdiction and as it seems to be a grey area, would the minister look into the matter? Would he also indicate whether or not he has received any representations or requests from the government of Nova Scotia regarding this matter?

subtopic: ACADIA FISHING COMPANY AND BOOTH FISHERIES-ASSISTANCE IN MEDIATING STRIKE
speechtext: Yes, Mr. Speaker, I will do that. Because of the fact that my next duty day is Monday, I will take the liberty of communicating privately with the hon. member in the meantime.

speechtext: Mr. Speaker, I would like to ask the Minister of Consumer and Corporate Affairs whether the Prices and Incomes Commission considers it to be within its jurisdiction or responsibility to engage in short-term economic forecasting as to trends in this country?
